item.title: Growth Mindset for Kids: How to Teach Children to See Challenges as Opportunities
item.description: As parents, we all want our kids to succeed—but what if the key to success isn’t just talent or intelligence, but how they think about challenges? Research shows that children who develop a growth mindset—the belief that abilities can be improved with effort and learning—are more resilient, motivated, and successful in the long run.In a recent episode of Big Little Emotions, SEL expert Chitra Ravi highlighted the importance of teaching kids to view setbacks as opportunities rather than failures.
